packageRules.description: @rollup/plugin-babel requires Babel 7 and makes the installation fail with Babel 8; Babel 8 also removed the `useBuiltIns` option of the build
Version 4 of the plugin requires Svelte 5 and crashes on Svelte 4 components

DOMPurify 3 dropped Internet Explorer 11 and passes markup on unsanitized there instead of failing; a vulnerability alert can still propose it outside allowedVersions, so also stop it from automerging
